<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Currency and bond pressure:</strong> The Indian rupee recorded its largest one-day decline in over three weeks, pressured by a stronger dollar and rising US yields, testing the RBI&#x27;s defense levels.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>External factors:</strong> Market sentiment was bolstered by strong H1 performance on Wall Street and positive developments regarding Iran&#x27;s participation in Doha talks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
